f. (-क्षा)
Wishing to bathe or plunge into.
E.
मस्ज to bathe, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Wishing to bathe, to plunge into, to be immersed in.
E.
मस्ज to bathe, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-षा)
Desire or purpose to destroy.
E.
मथि to shake, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to destroy, shake, overturn, &c.
E.
मथ to injure, desid. v., उ aff.

(ऋ) मीमृ r. 1st cl. (मीमति)
1 To go, to move.
2 To sound.

m. (-कः)
A Mīmāṃsaka, a follower of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy.
E.
मीमांसा the doctrine so termed, and वुन् aff.

f. (-सा)
One of the philosophical systems of the Hindus, or rather a two-fold system, the two parts of which form two of the six Darśanas or schools of philosophy; the first part, the Pūrva Mīmāṃsā, or Mīmāṃsā simply, originates with [] the Muni JAIMINI, and illustrates the Karma kāṇḍa of the Vedas, or the practical part, (the ritual,) of religion and devotion, including also moral and legal obligations. The second part, or Uttara Mīmāṃsā, ascribed to VYĀSA, is the same as the Vedānta, founded on the Jñāna-kāṇḍa or theological portion of the Vedas, and treating of the spiritual worship of the Supreme Being or soul of the universe.
E.
मान to seek knowledge, aff. अङ् and टाप्; the derivative takes the augment of the reduplicate form of the verb.
